name: Shirataka (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Shirataka town emblem in white and black: a white stylised hawk's head outlined in black.
history: Municipal flag of Shirataka, a town in Yamagata Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 1 April 2004; the emblem dates from 28 September 1959.

features.role: Shirataka town emblem — a white stylised hawk's head outlined in black
